images.filename: Candlelight Action vigil-protest for Itaewon disaster, Nov 5, 2022 - 7.jpg
images.caption: A candlelight vigil-protest of thousands of people was held on the large main street Sejong-daero in Jung-gu, Seoul near Seoul City Hall for the victims of the Seoul Halloween crowd crush at the end of the mourning period on Saturday, November 5, 2022. It was held by the progressive group Candlelight Action, who have held prior regular protests against the government of President Yoon Suk-yeol, and was based at City Hall Subway Station, Exit 7, starting at 5:00 p.m. The protestors hold signs which they received at one of the organizer's tents. The white sign reads in English "We pay tribute to the victims of the Itaewon disaster." And the black sign says, "Retirement is a tribute." or "Stepping down is an expression of condolence," which is a message directed at President Yoon.
images.alt: A candlelight vigil-protest of thousands of people was held on the large main street Sejong-daero in Jung-gu, Seoul near Seoul City Hall for the victims of the Seoul Halloween crowd crush at the end of the mourning period on Saturday, November 5, 2022. It was held by the progressive group Candlelight Action, who have held prior regular protests against the government of President Yoon Suk-yeol, and was based at City Hall Subway Station, Exit 7, starting at 5:00 p.m. The protestors hold signs which they received at one of the organizer's tents. The white sign reads in English "We pay tribute to the victims of the Itaewon disaster."
